mentions.name: AI Token Pricing
mentions.description: This tool helps users price their service credits or plans for LLM-based offerings, reflecting the credits/tokens cost structure of AI services.
mentions.source_excerpt: With LLMs, the cost structure is credits/tokens all the way down. This month, I built a tool to help you price your service credits or plans at https://aitokenpricing.com.
